## What's Changed

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/maximtop/opencode-session-namer/compare/v0.1.0...v0.1.1

First release.

## What it does

Renames an opencode session once, right after the first user message:

- First message referencing a GitHub PR → `[repo] KEY-123 Review pull/N <PR title>`. Full URLs with any suffix (`…/pull/N/changes`, `#diff…`, `?…`) and the short `owner/repo#N` form are detected; short forms are verified via `gh` (file references like `src/rename.ts#42` are dropped). With `prLinkLlm` on, a small locked-down child session can extract a PR reference mentioned without a link.
- Otherwise, inside a git project → `[project] KEY-123 <opencode auto-title>`; the issue key comes from the branch in `.git/HEAD`. Linked worktrees resolve to the main repo name + worktree branch key.
- Overlong titles are shortened deterministically, or via the configured `small_model` when `smartShorten` is on.

## Safety

- Renames exactly once per session — the state file survives restarts.
- A title set by hand or by another tool is never replaced; a late re-write of the recorded auto-title is corrected at most once, before the first idle.
- `gh` is pinned to `github.com` — a PR URL from an untrusted message can never redirect your token to another host (GHES deliberately unsupported).
- Deterministic by default; optional LLM modes run in throwaway child sessions with all tools disabled.

## Install

From a checkout:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/maximtop/opencode-session-namer
cd opencode-session-namer
pnpm install
ln -s "$PWD/src/index.ts" ~/.config/opencode/plugins/session-namer.ts
```

npm install (`"plugin": ["@maximtop/opencode-session-namer"]`) lands with the first npm publish. Config: `~/.config/opencode/session-namer.json` — all keys optional, see [README](https://github.com/maximtop/opencode-session-namer#readme). PR-based naming needs the [`gh`](https://cli.github.com) CLI; without it the plugin degrades to project naming.

**Full changelog**: [initial implementation](https://github.com/maximtop/opencode-session-namer/pull/1) — 54 review findings addressed across 3 review rounds.
